origin.summary: The owner selected L-14 so one shareable diagnostic bundle can collect the current recipe and evidence without exposing source bytes or private workstation identity by default.

state.current_summary: PL-0024/L-14 is complete: one explicit Results and Run Record action creates a collision-safe six-entry privacy-safe support ZIP with manifest hashes, sanitized and bounded evidence, fail-closed identity checks, and no inspection or product-state mutation.

objective.summary: Create one explicit privacy-safe support ZIP for the current Run Record containing an auditable manifest, sanitized recipe, bounded session log excerpt, source identity, Source Quality evidence, and current result.
constraints: Omit source and mesh bytes, absolute paths, full application logs, workstation identity, and user identity by default.
Do not execute inspection, reload the source, recalculate Source Quality, or mutate recipe, selection, preview, published output, or Run Record state.
Use the current Run Record and existing in-memory Workbench session log; do not add a second diagnostic or logging framework.
Use one collision-safe ZIP with an explicit manifest and standard-library compression only.
Keep missing or incompatible recipe and quality evidence explicit instead of silently fabricating or omitting it.

criteria.text: The ZIP manifest identifies its schema, privacy mode, current run, every payload name/size/SHA-256, included data classes, and default omissions.

The bundle contains a sanitized recipe, at most 200 newest session log entries, source identity, exact already-recorded Source Quality evidence, and current result without source bytes, absolute paths, user identity, or machine identity.
Export is collision-safe and fail-closed for an invalid current Run Record, reports missing or mismatched optional evidence explicitly, and causes no inspection execution or product-state mutation.
Results exposes one localized, accessible, semantically themed support-bundle action with a visible privacy boundary in Wide and Compact layouts.
Focused privacy checks, affected regressions, Release build, current Wide/Compact actual-EXE evidence, documentation, Proofline validation, and diff hygiene pass.
